title: Man Feeding Deer in Yosemite Park, 1952 Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Milt & Mother letting deer lick sugar out of their hands in Yosemite Park
Sept. 1952 -
Mich. trip from Calif. with folk

449
description: A charming snapshot from September 1952 showing a man named Milt leaning down to let a wild deer eat or lick sugar from his hand, while holding a vintage camera case in his other hand. In the background, an older woman in a printed dress and short-sleeved blouse interacts with a second deer amidst the towering pine trees of Yosemite National Park. This photograph captures the mid-century American road-trip culture and the now-discouraged practice of feeding park wildlife by hand.
